stem: Based on the photograph and your knowledge of U.S. history, how did battles such as Okinawa influence U.S. strategy in World War II?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States chose to drop the atomic bomb rather than invade Japan to end the war.

options.label: B
options.text: The United States chose to focus on winning the war against Germany before winning the war against Japan.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States chose to allow forces of the Soviet Union to invade Japan in order to reduce casualties.

options.label: D
options.text: The United States chose to intern some of its citizens in the hope that Japan would surrender.

visual_elements: The black and white photograph shows extensive damage and debris on a U.S. aircraft carrier, the USS Bunker Hill, caused by kamikaze attacks during the battle in May 1945.
